touchpoints_source.notes: Integration Catalog enriches Dependency Graph touchpoints; no separate inventory produced.

contract_summary.inputs_summary: POST /user/signin with username/password JSON body; GET /ava/oneview/internal/api/dashboard/rag/list with query params (weekEndingDates, projectTypes)
contract_summary.outputs_summary: Login returns X-Ava-Access-Token header; RAG list returns JSON with deliveryRagProjectList array containing project, client, ragStatus fields

failure_behavior.retry_policy: Fallback to previous day's data if current day returns empty list; no explicit retry on HTTP failure
failure_behavior.idempotency_signal: GET requests are idempotent; POST /signin is not idempotent but stateless
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: No explicit try-catch around RestTemplate calls; relies on Spring default exception handling

evidence: src/main/java/com/collaberadigital/cove/service/impl/OneViewServiceImpl.java:70-90 (fallback to previous day if empty response)

contract_summary.inputs_summary: JPA repository method calls (findByEmail, save, findById, etc.) with entity objects or query parameters
contract_summary.outputs_summary: Entity objects (UserEntity, AccessToken, RefreshToken, ActionHistory) or Optional<Entity>
contract_summary.schema_hint: Tables: users, access_token, refresh_token, action_history; JPA entities define schema via annotations

failure_behavior.retry_policy: Spring Data JPA default retry (none); connection pool handles transient failures
failure_behavior.idempotency_signal: Reads are idempotent; writes (save) are not idempotent without application-level checks
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: Repository methods throw exceptions on failure; caught by service layer or global exception handler

contract_summary.inputs_summary: Email address, subject, FreeMarker template name, template model (name, description)
contract_summary.outputs_summary: Boolean success/failure; throws CustomException on failure

failure_behavior.retry_policy: No retry; throws CustomException immediately on send failure
failure_behavior.idempotency_signal: Not idempotent; duplicate sends possible on retry at caller level
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: Catches Exception, logs stack trace, throws CustomException with code 451

contract_summary.inputs_summary: Service registration metadata (instance ID, hostname, preferIpAddress)
contract_summary.schema_hint: Eureka client library handles protocol; no explicit request/response models in application code

failure_behavior.retry_policy: Eureka client library default retry and failover
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: Eureka client library handles failures; application does not explicitly handle Eureka errors

contract_summary.outputs_summary: Prometheus text format metrics (application metrics, JVM metrics, Spring Boot metrics)
contract_summary.schema_hint: Micrometer registry exports metrics in Prometheus format

failure_behavior.retry_policy: Prometheus server retries scrape on failure
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: Spring Actuator handles endpoint errors; application does not explicitly handle scrape failures

evidence: src/main/resources/application-dev.properties:10-15 (actuator endpoints enabled: health, info, prometheus, metrics)

contract_summary.inputs_summary: Docker image push/pull commands via AWS CLI and kubectl
contract_summary.outputs_summary: Image manifest and layer storage confirmation

failure_behavior.retry_policy: AWS CLI and Docker client default retry
failure_behavior.idempotency_signal: Image push is idempotent (same tag overwrites); pull is idempotent
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: CI/CD pipeline (buildspec.yml) does not explicitly handle ECR errors; relies on AWS CLI exit codes

contract_summary.inputs_summary: kubectl apply commands with deployment.yaml and service.yaml manifests
contract_summary.outputs_summary: Kubernetes resource creation/update confirmation; pod status
contract_summary.schema_hint: Kubernetes Deployment and Service resource schemas

failure_behavior.retry_policy: kubectl retries on transient API failures; Kubernetes controller retries pod creation on failure
failure_behavior.idempotency_signal: kubectl apply is idempotent; Kubernetes reconciliation loop ensures desired state
failure_behavior.error_handling_signal: CI/CD pipeline (buildspec.yml) does not explicitly handle kubectl errors; relies on exit codes

evidence: buildspec.yml:post_build phase (kubectl apply and rollout restart commands)
kubernetes/deployment.yaml (Deployment resource with 2 replicas, resource limits)

patterns.description: JWT-based authentication with access tokens (30-minute validity) and refresh tokens (24-hour validity). Tokens stored in database with expiration and revocation flags. BCrypt password hashing for user credentials.
evidence: src/main/java/com/collaberadigital/cove/service/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:145-155 (token generation on login with revocation of old tokens)

patterns.description: No explicit application-level retry logic for most integrations. OneView API has fallback to previous day's data if current day returns empty. Relies on library defaults (Eureka client, Spring Data JPA connection pool, AWS CLI, kubectl).
evidence: No explicit retry annotations or libraries (e.g., Spring Retry) detected in service implementations

patterns.description: GET requests are idempotent. POST/PUT operations (user registration, login, admin updates) are not explicitly designed for idempotency; duplicate requests may cause duplicate side effects (e.g., multiple emails sent).
No explicit timeout configuration detected in application code. Relies on library and infrastructure defaults (RestTemplate, JDBC driver, JavaMailSender, Eureka client).
evidence: No timeout properties in application-dev.properties for RestTemplate, JDBC, or mail
No custom RestTemplate bean with timeout configuration detected

patterns.description: Prometheus metrics exposed via Spring Actuator on /actuator/prometheus. Logging with SLF4J/Logback (commented out debug logging in properties). No distributed tracing (e.g., Sleuth, Zipkin) detected.

limits_or_unknowns: Timeout configuration not explicitly set in application code; relies on library defaults.
Auth patterns for AWS ECR and AWS EKS not visible in application code; handled by AWS CLI and kubectl.
Eureka authentication mechanism not visible in application code; may be handled by infrastructure or Eureka server configuration.
Prometheus scrape authentication not visible; may be unauthenticated or handled by Kubernetes network policies.
No API specification (OpenAPI/Swagger) found; contract details inferred from controller and service code.

No distributed tracing or correlation ID propagation detected.
